facts.fact: NBS and OCGS Zanzibar published the 2024 Updated Statistical Business Register report, compiled from Tanzania Revenue Authority and Zanzibar Revenue Authority tax records plus establishment surveys, giving 257,405 establishments in 2024 against 219,371 in 2023 (+17.3%); figures cover 2024, release date taken from the source's published date as the report itself is dated September 2025.

note: Five-year strategy (Dec 2021) that only plans administrative-data MoUs, annual abstracts and vital statistics reports; no event stated as done, so no fact.

facts.fact: NBS and the Zanzibar Office of the Chief Government Statistician, under TSMP II (2022/23-2026/27), developed the first manual for integrating administrative data into official statistics, after assessing how sector bodies produce administrative data; the manual states that administrative data is not yet used for official statistics because of quality gaps, and the document carries no date, so its 2024 year is the published date and the as_of.

facts.fact: The Tanzania Police Force and NBS issued the crime statistics report for January-December 2020 in January 2021, compiled by the Police statistics unit from crime reports received at police stations; as_of is the report's January 2021 date.
facts.system: Takwimu za Hali ya Uhalifu na Matukio ya Usalama Barabarani, Januari - Desemba 2020

facts.fact: The Police statistics unit states it receives all crimes reported at police stations nationwide, analyses and stores them, and prepares the crime situation reports; the 2020 report is dated January 2021.
facts.system: Takwimu za Hali ya Uhalifu na Matukio ya Usalama Barabarani, Januari - Desemba 2020

facts.fact: The Police statistics unit states it prepares the crime situation report every quarter, half-year and year; the January-December 2020 edition is dated January 2021.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's Annual Health Statistical Tables and Figures 2024, published September 2025 and covering January-December 2024, is compiled from routine facility records (HMIS registers and tally sheets) aggregated in DHIS2 from 11,805 health facilities, with HRHIS and the Health Facility Registry as further record sources.
facts.system: Annual Health Statistical Tables and Figures 2024

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health states that, since 2009, its Monitoring and Evaluation Unit has consistently published the Annual Health Statistical Tables and Figures report each year for the preceding calendar year; this edition was published September 2025.
